data.description: Prime Location | Two Balconies | Burj Khalifa Facing
data.display_address: Sobha Creek Vistas Grande, sobha_hartland, Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Dubai
data.long_description:
Welcome to your future home, where luxury meets comfort in the heart of Dubai.

Provident Real Estate is delighted to present this spacious and elegantly designed one-bedroom apartment in Creek Vista Grande, located in the sought-after community of Sobha Hartland. Positioned on a mid-floor, this stunning residence boasts two private balconies with spectacular views of the Burj Khalifa, Downtown Dubai, and breathtaking sunsets. 

Property Details:

Location: Sobha Creek Vista Grande, Sobha Hartland
Type: Apartment for Sale
Bedrooms: 1 
Bathrooms: 2
Size: 775 sq.ft.
Parking: 1 Covered Parking Space
View: Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai
Floor: Mid floor 

Amenities:

Fully fitted kitchen
Built-in wardrobes
Shared gym
Outdoor swimming pool
Community parks
Polyclinic
Pet-friendly environment

The apartment is thoughtfully designed, featuring a fully fitted kitchen and high-quality finishes, in line with Sobha’s renowned standards. Sobha Creek Vista Grande is ideally positioned just 10 minutes away from Downtown Dubai, Dubai Fountains, and Dubai Mall. Residents also benefit from easy access to international schools located within a 5-minute drive.

Sobha Hartland offers the perfect balance between tranquil green landscapes and vibrant city living, making it one of the most desirable communities in Dubai.
